meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过命令行跑电商流程:从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据、生成上架模板与推广文案、做短视频,还能搜闲鱼捡漏并一键代发下单。
howto.when: 当你开展跨境电商业务(选品、上架、推广等),或做闲鱼二手捡漏时触发。完整采集 1688/闲鱼需已登录浏览器,视频生成需 ffmpeg。

say.text: 帮我用 1688 采集蓝牙耳机,抓两页并下载图片
say.note: 商品详情与图片会存到本地

say.text: 把采集到的商品清洗后生成 Shopify 上架模板
say.note: 低毛利、低评分商品会被过滤

say.text: 在闲鱼找 1000 元以内、支持 4K 的投影仪,给捡漏评分
say.note: 按价格、成色、信誉等维度打分

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can run this CLI to scrape 1688 products, clean data, generate listing templates and promo copy, make short videos, search Xianyu for bargains, and place dropship orders.
howto.when_en: Triggered for cross-border ecommerce work like product selection, listing, or promotion, or Xianyu bargain hunting. Full scraping needs a logged-in browser; video needs ffmpeg.

say_en.text: Scrape 1688 for 'bluetooth earphones', 2 pages, download images
say_en.note: Saves product details and images locally

say_en.text: Clean the scraped products and generate a Shopify listing template
say_en.note: Low-margin, low-score items get filtered out

say_en.text: Find Xianyu projectors under 1000 yuan with 4K, score them
say_en.note: Scores by price, condition, seller reputation
